title: Data Product & Semantic Ownership
summary: A governed, owned, reusable data asset with a clear contract.
explain: A data product has an owner, contract (fields/SLAs), quality rules, and consumers. When Finance and Sales each invent 'Net Revenue', dashboards conflict. Semantic ownership and lineage beat spreadsheet extracts.
analogy: A product SKU with a spec sheet — not a mystery box of columns.
mnemonic: PRODUCT not DUMP: Owner + contract + quality — not a pile of tables.
useCases: Greenfield design workshop: decide if “Data Product & Semantic Ownership” is required given constraints (latency, clean-core, team skills).
Incident bridge: symptoms appear; use “Data Product & Semantic Ownership” to classify the failing hop before changing config.
Finance and Sales disagree on “revenue” — Data Product & Semantic Ownership forces one productized definition.
